Omar (Finance): Alert: unexpected unlabeled GPU spend detected in project gamma-batch around 01:10-02:20 UTC, ~$6.3k. No cost_center label.
Zoe (Eng-ML): Thanks Omar — could be the new nightly batch job we kicked off for embedding refresh. I'll check run ids.
Devin (Eng-Platform): Noted. We also pushed a permissive autoscale rule to the batch pool yesterday. It may have matched gamma-batch. Rolling that flag back now.
Omar (Finance): Quick billing excerpt:
```
project_id | sku_description | start_time | cost
gamma-batch | GPU hours | 2026-04-05T01:12:00Z | 3200.00
gamma-batch | GPU hours | 2026-04-05T01:55:00Z | 3100.00
```
No labels on these rows.
CostBot: Budget monitor: "batching-refresh" exceeded soft threshold by 115%. Alert sent to #finance.
Clara (SalesOps): If this is customer-facing batch work, Sales wants clarity on billable vs internal. Please flag if any external customer task.
Zoe (Eng-ML): It's internal embed index refresh for Search v2 (internal infra). Not billable. We'll stop pending verification.
Devin (Eng-Platform): Autoscale rollback complete. Added deny rule preventing unlabeled projects from scaling beyond baseline in batch pool.
Omar (Finance): Proposed fix: snapshot rows, backfill cost_center:internal-search, create internal charge. Will you provide owners list so we can allocate?
Zoe (Eng-ML): Owner list: Zoe, Malik (SRE), and the search team lead. I'll DM Malik to confirm.
Omar (Finance): Snapshot saved to gs://fin-snapshots/gamma-1781234567.csv. Ticket FIN-2026-578 created. I'll run backfill after owners confirmation.
Clara (SalesOps): Confirmed not billable to customers. Product ok to absorb internally.
CostBot: Note: retro tags update internal dashboards only, provider invoice unchanged.
Omar (Finance): Owners assigned: Omar -> snapshot + backfill + invoice; Zoe -> stop jobs + owner confirmation; Devin -> autoscale rollback + deny rule. Target: COB 2026-04-05.
Zoe (Eng-ML): On it. I'll also push a runtime guard to require cost_center label for any high-alloc job.
Devin (Eng-Platform): Will add an early alert at 50% threshold for this pool.
Omar (Finance): Thanks everyone — will update FIN-2026-578 when backfill is complete.
